# Brahmstorm

> Free tool that generates Suno AI music prompts and lyrics that actually sound like the song you imagined. No signup, 5 daily generations, multilingual (English, Portuguese, Spanish, French).

Brahmstorm is a prompt forge for [Suno AI](https://suno.com). It solves the blank-page problem: instead of staring at Suno's prompt box trying to remember the right tags, you pick blocks (genre, mood, instrumentation, vocals, era, tempo) or describe a feeling and the system composes a prompt that respects Suno's actual limits.

## Core product

- [App](https://brahmstorm.com/#app): The studio where users build prompts and generate lyrics.
- [Landing](https://brahmstorm.com): Marketing page with quick-start vibes and a demo.
- [Blog](https://brahmstorm.com/blog/): Tactical guides on getting Suno to render the song you hear in your head.

## Key facts about Brahmstorm

- Free. No signup. 5 generations per day, reset at 00:00 UTC.
- Two entry modes: **Poet mode** (start from a feeling) and **Producer mode** (pick blocks).
- Generates Suno prompts AND song lyrics — and converts between them (prompt → lyrics, lyrics → prompt) in any of the 4 supported UI languages.
- Supports reference tracks (paste a Spotify/YouTube URL or song name) — the AI uses it as a compass without copying.
- Album mode generates 5 cohesive tracks with shared sonic universe but different narrative angles.
- Multilingual: English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, French.
- Built with React + Vite + Tailwind + Anthropic Claude API.

## Suno prompt limits (verified by us)

- Genres: 3 maximum
- Moods: 4 maximum
- Instruments: 6 maximum
- Voice descriptors: 2 maximum
- Era tags: 2 maximum
- Production tags: 2 maximum
- Prompt total: under 950 characters (Suno's hard limit is 1000)
